animation_tools: Open animation editing, cleanup, Smart Key, and snapping commands.
smart_key: Set a key at the current frame using the active Graph Editor, Channel Box, or object context.
smart_key_all: Set keys on every keyable scalar channel of the selected objects.
euler_filter: Apply the smart Euler filter to rotation curves on the selected objects and animation layers.
snap: Move sub-frame keys on the selected objects and animation layers, including layer weights, onto whole frames.
clear_animation: Delete animation from the selected objects and animation layers.
A highlighted Time Slider range limits which keys are deleted.
crop: Keep keys inside the range, copy them to the key clipboard, and remove keys outside it.
remove_redundant: Remove redundant keys from the selected objects and animation layers using the mode selected from the right-click menu.
remove_redundant_flat: Remove only interior keys from flat-value runs. Non-flat motion keys are left untouched.
remove_redundant_all: Simplify all redundant keys on the active curves while preserving the current key selection.
remove_static: Remove static animation from the selected objects and animation layers.
reverse: Reverse keys on the selected objects and animation layers in time.
copy_keys: Copy a highlighted Time Slider range, selected Graph Editor keys or tangents, or all keys on the selected objects and animation layers.
cut_keys: Cut a highlighted Time Slider range, selected Graph Editor keys or tangents, or all keys on the selected objects and animation layers.
delete_keys: Delete a highlighted Time Slider range, selected Graph Editor keys or tangents, or keys at the current frame.
paste_keys: Paste at the current time or selected Graph Editor key. Select channels to remap the copied animation.
paste_keys_relative: Paste with a value offset while preserving the destination anchor key and its tangents.
go_to_next_key: Go to the next key on the selected objects and animation layers.
go_to_previous_key: Go to the previous key on the selected objects and animation layers.
go_to_next_frame: Move forward one frame without clamping to the playback range. Repeated triggers accumulate.
go_to_previous_frame: Move backward one frame without clamping to the playback range. Repeated triggers accumulate.
clear_selected: Clear the current Graph Editor key selection.
select_scene: Select every animation curve in the scene.
delete_before: Delete selected objects' keys before the current frame.
delete_after: Delete selected objects' keys after the current frame.
